batting.dismissal: c SL Malinga b C Nanda

batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b ST Jayasuriya

batting.dismissal: c AM Nayar b DJ Bravo

batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b ST Jayasuriya

batting.name: YV Takawale
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b SK Trivedi

batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b SK Warne

balls.text: low full toss on middle, driven down to long-on for a single, attempts an impossible second and is run-out while running to the bowler's end
tossed up outside off, goes for the slog-sweep, it zips away and he misses
goes for the reverse-sweep again and top edges it straight to short third man, Rajasthan have lost their way here at the death
reverse-swept straight to short third, failed to beat him
dug out back past the bowler, in fact, over him for a single to long-on

smashes it straight down Bravo's throat at long-on, bowled flat and full outside off, swats it well but didn't get the desired elevation, Bravo runs in and takes it comfortably. Well, not quite, he just managed to clasp it as it was slipping out
and again, this one was in the slot he picked it, had a swing but was nowhere near it, bowled at 103.7 kmph, Bravo recovered well after bowling those two wides
slower one bowled fullish outside off, made room to cart that over cover, didn't connect, crucial dot balls these
short on middle, mistimes a pull wide of midwicket for a single

easy catch to Nayar at third man, banged it short outside off, went for the upper-cut, seemed he had connected well initially but not really, landed safe in the palms of the fielder waiting to pouch it
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, made room and the bowler chased him,, worked it away to deep square leg
down the leg side again, tries to clip it fine, misses but won't mind the extra ball, good chance here to make up for some lost runs from the previous overs
down the leg side this time, tried to hook it fine, missed but it's too high and the umpire immediately calls it a wide
banged in short on middle, went for the pull but failed to make contact, another dot ball
slower one this time, bowled at 123.8 kmph, the legcutter, he failed to pick that, tried to guide it to third man, got a faint edge that fell well short of the keeper
coming round the wicket to the left hander, hurls it in the blockhole outside off, digs it out wide of cover for a quick single
banged in short on middle, dropped between point and cover for a quick single
beautifully timed, bowled full on middle, made room and drove it with a full face wide of mid-off for a pressure-relieving four
straying down the leg side, concedes a run and an extra ball
length ball outside off, gets his bat under it and steers it towards deep point
bowled it full and wide, failed to reach it, was a little late on it as well, quick, at 139.3 kmph
back of a length outside off, makes room to slash that over point, makes no contact, a good over comes to an end
Jadeja made room and Dhawal chased him, bowled it short outside leg, tries to fend it away, gloves it on the leg side and gets a single
too short, down the leg side, and too high as well, given a wide
slower one bowled short outside off, makes room and bunts it down to deep cover
bouncer banged in on middle, ducks under it, tidy over so far, one for the over
short on middle, fends it away towards fine leg for a single
back of a length outside off, reaches for a cut, fails to make contact
bouncer outside off, Chitnis lets it go
superb yorker, let it rip there, bowled at 138.1 kmph, targeted the leg stump and hit, Quiney failed to bring his bat down, was too quick and the stick went for a walk
back of a length outside off, upper cut towards third man for a single
slower ball bowled short outside off, bunted it down deep cover
slower one, failed to pick that, thought of a pull but withdrew once he realised there was no chance, bowled at 117.2 kmph
short of a good length on the off, guided down to third man for a single
slightly short outside off, chopped wide of point for a single
appeal for run out, quicker one bowled full outside off, worked away wide of long-on, scampers back for the second, it's an accurate throw at the bowler's end but the dive saves Quiney
short of a good length outside off, chopped down to point
comes round the wicket, bowled fullish on the off, pushed back to the bowler
this is an onslaught, helped by some poor bowling, hurled it short and wide, made room and cut it perfectly in the gap between point and short third
fullish outside off, gets forward and steers it firmly behind point for a boundary, Harbhajan being dealt with now
19 off the over, the agony continues, fullish on leg stump, got the direction completely wrong off those two balls, flicked away over short fine to bring up his maiden IPL fifty
the fine leg was brought up and he smashed it straight over his head, short outside leg, an atrocious ball considering the field he's set, rocked back and pulled it away for a flat six
bowled it short outside off this time, kept it down, bunted it to deep point for a single

massive six, short on the off, not too short but enough for him to cash in, pulled it away contemptuously over deep midwicket, sailed into the crowd, brought up to 100, they've got themselves into an excellent position now
slower one bowled short on the off stump, had shaped himself up for the pull, adjusted well to the pace and paddled it to deep square leg
short of a good length on the off, guided down to third man
but connects it superbly this time, bowled on leg stump and spun in but had reached forward, played it with the spin and slog-swept it miles over the deep square-leg boundary
misses out on the slog-sweep, and it just escapes the off stump, flighted on middle, went after it but it spun away sharply to beat the swing of the bat
flighted on middle and off, driven neatly down the ground to long-off
short on the off, makes room and slaps it to deep cover for a single
full toss on leg stump, bunts it down to deep midwicket for a single
bowled it flat outside leg and got it to spin back in, tried to turn it away, was hit on the pads
flighted outside off, reached forward to push it towards cover
pitched it short outside off, dabbed it late towards point for a single
bowled it a touch too full there and Jadeja latched on, bending low to slog-sweep that powerfully between deep square leg and deep midwicket for four more
back of a length on the off, slapped down to deep cover
flighted outside leg stump, worked away behind square for a single
excellent shot, Jadeja gets into the act now, bowled short outside off, waited for it and cut it perfectly in the gap between point and cover
pushed it away towards point, called for a single which was turned down
good shot, bowled it short outside leg, swivelled and pulled it away over short fine for a boundary
held it back, bowled it short on the off, punched to deep cover
flighted on middle, sweeps it to deep square leg
lands slightly short on the off, punched down towards deep point for a single
straying down the leg side, clips his thighs as he lets it go
shortish on middle and leg, tickled behind square for a single

gone at the stroke of the timeout, happens for the umpteenth time, bowled it flat on middle, bent low and swept it straight to Malinga at deep square leg who dived forward to complete a well-judged catch
the quicker one on middle, defended back to the bowler
flighted outside off, eased towards deep point for a single
on middle and off, pushed down to long-on for a single
short of a good length on the off, spins in, punched down to deep midwicket
quickish on leg stump, tries to paddle it fine, is hit on the pads
poor ball promptly punished, short on middle, rocked back and pulled it away between deep square leg and deep midwicket for a one bounce four
quicker one bowled in the blockhole on middle, dug out back to Harbhajan
the straighter one, played for the spin, got an inside edge towards short fine, raced off for a single and made it easily despite the direct hit
slightly short outside off, taps it wide of Tendulkar at point for a single
coming round the wicket to the left hander, Quiney tries to sweep it square, is struck on the pads and manages to squeeze in a single
almost done in by the slower one, pushed it on a length again, went hard at it initially but checked his shot at the right time, managed to clear mid-off, and sneak a couple
he's better off bowling short, pushed it full and wide this time, got to the pitch and bludgeoned it wide of mid-off, sweetly struck
deceived by the slower one again, Yusuf was sucked in by the short ball, tried to upper cut that over the keeper but was too early into it, failed to pick it
full and wide, cashes in, makes room and slashes it behind point, was uppish but safe, beat third man comfortably for a boundary
follows that one with a slower one, bowled at 117 kmph, tried to dab it down to third man, missed
starts with a bouncer, banged in short on middle at around 135 kmph, took Yusuf by surprise, had no answer to it, just backed out, was almost done in by the pace
delicately done, quicker one bowled fullish outside off, dabs it just wide of point for a quick single
worked away through the midwicket region for a single
slightly short outside off, opens the face to push it towards short third

spin does the trick again, the boundaries had dried up, the scoring had been kept in check and Smith went after it as soon as he sensed an opportunity, short on middle, went for a pull, connected well but got the direction wrong, plays it straight into the palms of Duminy at deep midwicket
short of a length outside off, cut away straight to deep point
tossed up outside off, reaches forward and drops it dead
went through him, excellent over, quicker one bowled short outside off, he had already made room and missed it altogether as he tried to defend
goes for the sweep and misses, flighted on middle and spun away to beat the swing
pitches outside leg and raps him on the thighs as he tries to work that away, another leg bye
flighted outside leg stump, had already made space, tried to clear midwicket, but mistimed it, Bravo dived but the batsman had already made the run as he aimed at the stumps at the non-striker's end
held it back, rocked back and slapped it straight to point
tossed up outside leg, tries to tickle it fine, clips the pads and they get a leg bye

valiant effort from Malinga, straying on the pads, shouldn't be doing that especially when there's no fine leg, flicks it away fine, Malinga gives chase from square leg and drags it back in with an awkward slide, but an effective one
delicately done, he's a power player but is now showing his deft touches, full and wide, reached for it and opened the face at the last moment to steer it wide of third man
got an inside edge there, tried to flay it in front of cover, didn't connect well, caught the keeper on the shoe
back of a length again, bunts it down to deep cover, a lot of mistimed cuts and slaps
back of a length outside off, tries to dab that down, misses
Smith attacks, bowled on a length outside off, in the slot for him, frees his arms and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary
short and wide, bowling to his field here, bunted down to deep cover for a single
does so successfully this time, short and wide, guides it gently down to third man
back of a length outside off, tries to run it down, misses
picked it early, banged it short outside off, rocked back and pulled it over mid-on, got a lot of elevation on that but it rolled down to the ropes, Quiney's looking good
back of a length outside off, chopped down to point this time, didn't time it well enough, there have been a few of those today
back of a length outside off, there's cover for that shot though, cut it away, but straight to deep point
zipped back in and beat him through the gate, skid off the pitch and Quiney was fortunate it bounced more than it should have
good length outside off, pushed away to cover
dropped, a toughie, Duminy flings himself to his left, was sliced away by Smith, firmly hit but he was probably just a little late to react at point
back of a length outside off, chopped down straight to point this time, mistimed an attempted cut
nicely done, bowled short and wide, Quiney seized the length early, waited for it and cut it away well wide of a widish slip to the third-man boundary
bowled it on a shortish length on the off stump, at 128.2 kmph, dabbed behind point for a single
short on middle, whipped away wide of mid-on for a single, an unnecessary throw to the striker's end, a direct hit and they get one more off the ricochet
excellent stuff, more than compensates for the miss the previous ball, length ball outside off, gets to the pitch and drives it crisply wide of mid-off for his first boundary
Smith misses out, bowling to his strength, full on the pads, flicked away firmly but straight to square leg
back of a length on the off stump, rocks back and drops it towards cover
bang on the stumps, tight line on middle, defended towards midwicket
short of a good length on the off, drops it on the pitch and sets off for a single, Malinga rushes in to break down the stumps but the batsman is well in
back of a length outside off, chopped down to point
good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
bowled on a length outside off, gets forward and scoops it over cover, races to the boundary, Quiney's away
much fuller, but seemed to hold its line, left through to the keeper
slightly short this time, just erred in length, cut away wide of a diving point for a couple before third man cuts it off
probing line outside off, lands on a good length, left alone to the keeper
run out, full on middle, squeezes it to cover and sets off for a single, he lobs a throw back to the bowler who throws down the stumps to seal a thriller!!
fullish on middle, pushed towards cover for a single, Rajasthan wouldn't mind that

run out, Mumbai are committing suicide here, full toss outside off, tries to swing it away, gets a leading edge towards mid-off, tries to run through to complete a single, Yusuf Pathan at mid-off collects and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Nanda well short
yorker on middle, trapped in front, tries to dig it out in the leg side, is rapped on the pads and the umpire raises his finger, struck on the back foot and was plumb, would have hit middle and leg
beaten, swings way after pitching, tries to nudge it down to third man, misses, dot ball
full toss outside off, dabbed to cover and sets off, a throw to the non-striker's end but he fails to pick it cleanly and the batsman has completed the single
bowls the fourteenth wide of the innings, what a mess, gifts them a run down the leg side
dot ball, quicker one bowled full on the off, pushed back to the bowler,what a game
run out, was yorked on leg stump, tried to scamper a single after digging it out, didn't realise the ball was lying just short of the keeper, Ojha picks it up and clips the bails to find Nayar short
that's the decisive blow!! Flighted outside leg from round the wicket, he's made room, and smacks it cleanly in the gap between deep cover and long-off, goes all the way, and Mumbai have the edge
flighted outside off, smashes it down to long-on, well struck but straight to the fielder
quicker one bowled outside leg stump, tries to smash it through cover, mistimes it on the off side, gets a single
slower one bowled fullish outside off, slapped to extra cover for a single to keep the strike
full toss on the off, just punches it wide of Yusuf again at long-on for two more, excellent throw but the dive saves him

stunning fielding, or so it seemed, game on folks, slightly short outside off, pulls it away in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket, Yusuf Pathan stretches to flick it back in and crashes into the hoardings but his effort is in vain as he's made contact with the ropes, given a four, and the nerves pile on
short of a good length outside off, bends low and swings it away wide of a diving Chitnis at deep square leg, flung himself to is right but fails to reach it, a one bounce four
low full toss outside off, bends low and drags it to deep midwicket, poor fielding, or so it seemed,  Smith throws it straight into the umpire and they steal another single, it's all allowed
slower one bowled short on middle, pulls it towards deep square leg, but only gets a single
full toss, dismissed, smashed away between deep square leg and deep midwicket for a timely boundary, the last two balls messed it up for Botha there

it appeared for a moment that he missed out, full toss on leg stump, swings hard, doesn't connect well, but manages to squeeze the gap wide of Shane Warne at short fine, beats deep square-leg to the boundary
quicker one bowled on a good length outside off, Nayar made room but all he could manage was to push it back to the bowler
full on middle, gets under it and slams it down to long-on for a single
full toss on the off, bunts it down the ground to long-off
saw him make room and chased him, bowled it full on leg stump, tries to sweep, salvages a leg bye
reaches for it, taps it wide of cover for a quick single, a scare there as it seemed there would be overthrows but no damage done
short and wide, too wide, taking it further away with the spin, called one
slightly short outside off, makes room, dabs it wide of slip
missed run out, short on the off, punched wide of long-on, rushes back for the second and the throw to the non-striker's end is wayward, had it been on target, Harbhajan was a gonner

he's got him! Is that the decisive blow?? The legspinner, bowled flat on middle and turned just a hint, Tendulkar got way across the line to sweep it behind square, missed and was rapped on the pads, Warne went up immediately and the umpire didn't take long to raise his finger, looked pretty adjacent
quicker one bowled on middle, bowled flat, looked like the flipper, pushed away into the leg side for a single
tossed up outside off, tries to paddle it fine, gets a faint touch on the glove

spun into the right hander from down the leg side, tried to work it away but just missed leg stump, down the leg side still, could have flicked the pads but the umpire didn't think so, gives it a wide, Warne is annoyed, Ojha fumbles to add to his misery
quicker one bowled on a good length on the off, chipped wide of the bowler towards long-on for a couple more, 19 off it, just the over they needed
made room and Jadeja chased him, turned it away on the leg side for a single
another one, this time on the other side of the pitch, quick, flat and full, smashes it back past the bowler to beat long-on this time, fiercely struck, all power
four more, drilled down the ground in the same direction, sped off the bat and Botha this time had no chance

quicker ball bowled full outside off, made room and slammed it down the ground, hit it really hard and though Botha got his body behind it at long-off, was unable to stop it from rolling over the ropes
quicker ball bowled flat outside leg stump, a big wide, the keeper fumbles to allow one more
quickish on middle and leg, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
bowled short on the off, moved across and helped it down to deep square leg
slightly short on the off, slashes it away to third man to give Tendulkar the strike
there's a short midwicket in place and it lands just short of him, mistimed a pull there and was lucky that didn't carry
shortish on middle, whipped straight to midwicket
back of a length on the off, dropped short of point and scampers through, a needless throw at the striker's end and there's no one to back up, concedes an overthrow
he's dragged it on, what a timely blow! Short of a good length on the off, a hint of inward movement, tried to dab it down to third man, got an inside edge straight onto the stumps

that's disappeared, bowled flat, charged down the track, got to the pitch and struck it cleanly over long-on for a massive six, that was coming, sailed into the stands, first six of the Mumbai innings
slightly short on the off, makes room and bunts it behind point for a couple
fullish on middle, pushed back to the bowler
pushed off the front foot into the leg side for a single

falls just short, quicker one bowled flat outside off, went for the slog-sweep, didn't get the elevation, Chitnis charged forward from deep midwicket and dived but could not quite get under it, did well to stop it though, was powerfully struck
tossed up on leg stump, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
too wide down the leg side, given, there have been too many of these today
quicker, bowled short on middle, closes the face to work it in front of square for a single
tosses it up, Temdulkar is sucked in, charges down the track to strike that over long-off but the spin produces the leading edge that falls just short of deep point
short ball outside leg stump, given a wide
tries to dab it into the leg side, gets an inside edge onto his pads
Tendulkar goes inside out to loft that over extra cover, bisects the gap between long-off and deep cover perfectly, pitched full outside leg but he was quick on his feet
flighted outside off, driven off the front foot to cover

Warne does the trick, Rajasthan were testing his patience, bowled it slightly quicker on leg stump, tried to clear midwicket there but went off the bottom of the bat, was too early into the shot, and Yusuf at midwicket, right at the edge of the circle, rushed in to dive forward and take it inches from the ground

came back to over the wicket, bowled a low full toss outside off, made room and struck it cleanly but straight to deep cover, just a single, excellent stuff from Botha, recovered well after that 11-run over
in the blockhole again, outside off, defended onto the pitch
short on middle, went back to pull that square, was struck on the thighs, Botha went up but that was too high
saw him make room and hurled it full, dug out back to the bowler
flighted on leg stump, tried to sweep it down fine, struck his pads and lobbed up
tossed up outside off, gets across, closes the face and turns it wide of square leg
quickish on middle, gets back, works it away behind square for one more
bowled full on leg stump, swept away firmly but straight to deep square leg for a single
short of a good length on middle, worked away to deep square leg
flighted on the off, driven back to the bowler
quicker through the air, punched to deep cover for a single
flighted on middle and leg, tickled behind square for a single
flighted outside off, swept down wide of deep square leg for a couple more, Munaf cuts it off, but they get 11 off it, that wide really messed it up
spoils the over, bowled it short outside leg, Jayasuriya tried to slap it fine, missed and so did the keeper to concede five wides
fuller on middle and leg, closes the face and runs for a quick single

appeal for caught-behind, short outside off, spun back in sharply as he tried to late-cut that past short third, bounced much more than he anticipated, caught his shoulder on the way to the keeper, good decision by the umpire who shook his head immediately
bowled short on leg stump, tries to jab it past square leg, is struck on the pads, spun back in to strike him a touch high on the pads, would have gone over
firing it in the blockhole on the off, dug out to cover
tossed up outside off, coming round the wicket, pushed into the gap between long-off and deep cover for a well-run two
smashed away but straight to the fielder, Trivedi can breathe easy, bowled short on middle, pulled away straight to deep midwicket, only a single
banged it short on middle, helped it on its way behind deep square leg for a couple of runs
slower one bowled on a good length on middle, turned away wide of midwicket for a single
cramped him for room but he plays it delicately, dabbing it to third man with a slight leap
slightly short outside off, guided down to third man for a single
misses out, bowled short on middle, chased the batsman as he had already made room, tried to upper cut that past the keeper, missed, no damage done
oversteps, freehit time, slapped to long-off for a single, Tendulkar will have to deal with it, replays indicate it was a harsh call, had a part of his foot behind the crease
attempted flipper, bowled short of a length on the off, punched to cover off the back foot, nothing dramatic happened there, fairly straightforward over that, was treated with respect
eases it through the off side towards deep cover for a single
tossed up on the off, gets forward and defends to cover
flighted on middle and leg, turned away wide of square leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, quicker through the air, dropped short of cover for a quick single
starts of with a full toss on leg stump, driven to deep midwicket for a single
sweetly timed, slower one bowled full outside off, got to the pitch and chipped it over the in-field on the off side, gets a couple
kept low, got to the keeper on the bounce as Jayasuriya left it alone
back of a length, gets on the back foot and punches it wide of mid-off to get off the mark
angling it into the right hander, bowled on a good length outside off and it came in, left it alone

edged and gone, Rajasthan are piling on the pressure here, slower one there, bowled short on the off, got some good bounce there, caught Takawale on the glove as he tried to keep it down off the back foot, lobbed up towards the keeper Ojha who dived forward to take a sharp chance
short of a good length on the off, defended towards point, another dot ball
flighted it, landed slightly short on leg stump, he got forward and tried to whip it through the leg side, the ball spun away to take the top edge and Raut at mid-on took a straightforward catch
shortish outside off, chopped down behind point for a quick single
nicely done, tossed up outside leg, stepped out, got to the pitch and drove it to mid-on for a quick single
loopy, on middle and leg, turned away behind square for a single
beat the outside edge, tossed up on the off, got forward to defend, was the conventional legspinner, was almost done in by the spin
down the leg side, tries to work it away square, brushes the thighs on the way to short fine, they get a leg bye
nicely done, made some room for himself, Munaf pushed it full, picked the length early and chipped it over cover and point for a boundary, that'll ease the pressure a little
back of a length outside off, pushed it slow, at 111.9 kmph, tries to dab it down to third man, misses
targeting middle and off, length ball, bowled at 135.2 kmph, pushed through the line to mid-off
slower one there, bowled at 109.2 kmph, pushed off the front foot to cover
a shot more out of desperation than anything else, saw some width and swatted it back over the bowler's head, hardly any timing, cleared mid-on and managed to squeeze a couple
back of a length on the off, defended in front of cover
back of a length on the off, defended back down the pitch, we are heading for a close one folks, Rajasthan have started well here
probing him on the off stump, angling into the right hander, defended back to the bowler
short of a good length on middle, dropped into the leg side short of the bowler for a quick single
short of a good length on the off, punched wide of cover for a quick single
stopped on him, bowled on a good length outside off, just chipped it over the in-field, no real conviction there, Rajasthan are testing them
fullish on the off, worked away to midwicket from the crease
good length on the off, defended to cover off the front foot
back of a length on the off, defended short of cover off the back foot
good length on middle, defended back to the bowler

an atrocious shot, bowled it short, Bravo was tempted, looking to pull it over midwicket, it swung away and he ended up miscuing it with a sliced bat high on the leg side, Munaf, and two others converged, but it was finally the bowler himself who clasped it with the others jostling for a chance as well. Awkward, but all's well that ends well
good length on the off, defended with a full face to mid-on
full and wide, stays his ground and slices it down to third man, gets to him on the bounce
spun back in, tackled it well, dropping it short of point for a single to keep the strike the next over, impressive start for Takawale
beautifully timed, bowled quickish and full outside off, stepped out and drove it between cover and point for a boundary
cramping him there, bowling a tight line on middle, pushes it back to the bowler
held it back a touch and bowled it flat, guided to point
flighted outside off, reaches forward, opens the face and dabs it behind point for a couple
quicker one bowled flat on middle, clipped away to deep square leg
